question: ‘Mount Everest’ is related to ‘Mountain’ in the same way as ‘Nobel’ is related to ‘________’.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

__
 
• **Mount Everest** is one the names of 
the highest **mountains **in the world.

Similarly,

 
• **Nobel** is one the **prize** considered to be the most prestigious in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Fame - the state of being widely known or recognized
 
• Duty - a moral or legal obligation
 
• Book - a set of sheets of paper bound together.
 
• **Prize -** a reward for victory or superiority. Like Nobel prizes, Booker prize etc.
